text:
## The AML Process  
```
Suspicious Activity Detected
↓
Report to Compliance Team
↓
Investigation
↓
Report to FCA (if necessary)
↓
Law Enforcement Action
```

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Detection and Reporting Process
raw_entities.description: A multi-stage compliance process triggered when suspicious activity is detected on a customer account. The process requires reporting to the internal Compliance Team, conducting an investigation, and escalating to the FCA when necessary, with potential referral to law enforcement.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Detection
raw_entities.description: The initial trigger point in the AML process where suspicious activity is identified on a customer account, requiring immediate escalation to the Compliance Team for investigation.

raw_entities.name: SAR Filing to FCA
raw_entities.description: The obligation to file a Suspicious Activity Report to the FCA when an investigation determines that suspicious activity meets the threshold for regulatory reporting. Filing occurs conditionally based on investigation findings.
